invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new or original List, so the result is non-null.
The method return type is List<HoodieKey> and the returned object is always a List.
The deduplication can only remove elements, not add, so the result size is less than or equal to the input keys size.
Parallelism is typically a non-negative integer, as negative parallelism does not make sense in this context.
From usage within the method, keys is assumed to be non-null upon method completion.
